rv.q: Retro pleasure for anyone with tastes like mine.
Pike knows how to make nearly every moment count in this charming and touching, if slight, story of one woman's struggles to find herself—in and out of love.
Lloyd Webber’s modest, pocket-sized musical isn’t his finest work.
Listening to Pike’s voice, in such a beautiful match to the music, and watching her emotional interpretations almost make the storyline incidental.
The role of Emma is handled to perfection by Dani Pike...
Pike hits the emotional and vocal high notes and is a powerhouse for her vocal and acting skills alongside her stamina as well.
It’s that effort’s success, along with Pike’s glorious performance, that places Tell Me on a Sunday on the exceptional shelf and makes it such a smashing night of theater.

cn.t: Critics praise this intimate Andrew Lloyd Webber one-woman show, with Dani Pike earning acclaim for her powerful vocal performance and emotional depth in bringing Emma's romantic journey to life at Theo Ubique's perfectly suited venue.
